direct_first_party_core: rejection high run/close-above is a bullish failure observable

market_data.instrument_identity: OANDA US Nas 100 CFD/proxy; not CME NQ futures equivalence

entry.entry_bar: first complete OANDA M1 bar whose start is >= activation H1 bar close
entry.base_fill: ASK open plus 0.5 index points adverse slippage
entry.stress_fill: ASK open plus 1.0 index points adverse slippage

risk.stop_event: first later/current entry M1 bar with BID low <= stop_anchor
risk.stop_fill: if BID open <= stop_anchor use BID open, else stop_anchor; subtract applicable adverse exit slippage

target.classification: fixed measurement convention selected before outcomes
target.target_event: first later/current entry M1 bar with BID high >= target_price
target.target_fill: target_price minus applicable adverse exit slippage; favorable gap improvement is not credited

intrabar_order.entry_minute_events: entry occurs at ASK open; subsequent BID high/low events are eligible in that M1 bar

expiry.reason: fixed one-trading-day-equivalent measurement horizon, frozen before outcomes
expiry.unresolved_exit: market measurement at final eligible M1 BID close minus adverse exit slippage

signal_portfolio_policy.same_knowledge_time_deduplication: keep trigger with latest swing_confirmed_at_utc; tie break lexicographic trigger_id
signal_portfolio_policy.new_signal_after_exit: eligible at its own causal knowledge time only; skipped signals are never replayed later

economics.spread: historical OANDA ASK entry / BID exit

backward_oos_sequence.stage_1: reconstruct V3-C triggers on sealed 2010-2023 MID H1/H4 structure only
backward_oos_sequence.stage_2: seal trigger IDs and timestamps before M1 BID/ASK retrieval
backward_oos_sequence.stage_3: retrieve only M1 windows needed to measure sealed triggers and one-position-at-a-time sequence
backward_oos_sequence.stage_4: evaluate base and stress economics exactly once

classification.EDGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: sample >=100 and one or more PRELIMINARY_EDGE conditions fail

interpretation.profitable_edge_claim_applies_to: this frozen owner-operational V3-C measurement strategy on OANDA NAS100_USD backward historical OOS
